encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ἔργον μὰ τὸν Διόνυσον οὐκ εἴληφ’ ἐγώ,
ἀφ’ οὗ παρασιτῶ. μεμβράδας μοι κρεῖττον ἦν

note.p: 2. ἔργον add. Porson. εἴληχ’ Casaub. 3. παρασιτωι et μεμβράδας, non βεμβράδας, A. recte: nam illius formae testimonia se prolaturum promiserat 287 d. cf. Phrynich. 50.

loquitur parasitus opulenti alicuius peregrini, sed Graeci. praeferendum esse dicit victum tenuissimum cum homine Attico splendidissimis epulis Croesi alicuius ineruditi. 2. Phot. 12, 20 ἔργον· ὁ μισθός. καὶ λαβεῖν ἔργον τὸ μισθῶσαι ἑαυτόν. victum suum comice sic dicit parasitus. 3. μεμβράδες, apuarum genus, sunt pisces vilissimi. Arist. Vesp. 493. 5. ὀνησιφόρον κτλ., si eidem parasito tribuatur post κρεῖττον ἦν mirum in modum languidum, alteri personae dedi. sed fortasse ὀνησιφόρον ἦν τοῦτ’ ἄν. ὀνησιφόρος serioris est graecitatis. cf. adesp. 430, 11 Mein. Plut. Mor. 555 e. Lucian. Vit. auct. 26 extr.
